digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier context management and verdict banking
propositions: Completion-verification gate fails verdict-less when resource exhaustion occurs (budget exhaustion, runaway loops, token exhaustion) instead of producing a scored verdict
Per-criterion recovery fans out isolation evidence runs causing request amplification (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 worst-case requests with context re-send overhead)
Static 100K-char recovery context ceiling rejects valid tickets with larger context (c9f7: 121K chars) and lacks alignment with model capability
Duplicate read-only tool calls within agentic runs execute repeatedly instead of memoizing results (e.g. 144x identical search_files call in one run)

Recovery preflight verification must balance resource constraints (physical model context window + economic re-send spend ceiling) while preserving d59e no-elision and zero-billable-on-refusal invariants
Agentic verification can reduce request counts by pre-loading ranked file_impact contents with manifest-driven skeleton/full selection strategy instead of on-demand file fetching
